summary: This Form 6-K filed by Bright Minds Biosciences Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, provides notice of its upcoming Annual General Meeting. The filing includes the meeting date (March 31, 2026), record dates (February 10, 2026), and meeting location (Vancouver, BC). It also covers proxy-related distribution details. There is no mention of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other transformative event. The filing is a routine regulatory communication regarding the annual shareholder meeting, not a special-situation event.
